comment: cfgfiles.c config_erradd() raw-prints the offending rc line (pline("\n%s", origline) while the windows are not up) and then " * Line N: ..." messages. Patch 006 nomux_raw_putch() stores a byte only below column 80 and counts columns in bytes, so the 112-byte line loses its tail, and its byte at column 79, the first of a two-byte character, decodes as U+FFFD. The third line puts two-byte characters in the error text. Recorded on macOS (recorder/competitor-probes); the Linux recording is the same.
